protocol.selection: Validation macro-group MAE; candidates within 2% of best prefer simpler explanations. Test never selects models. Synthetic stress never selects the production winner.
protocol.interval: Held-out calibration residual q10/q50/q90, equal total weight per group. Nominal 80% marginal interval, measured coverage; no conditional or simultaneous guarantee.
protocol.target: Bank-only score at t+h, frozen current score engine; not a credit/default label
limitations: Organizer data are synthetic and have already been explored by the team
Only 24 months; six-month forecast has few independent temporal origins
Bank classifications and company metadata lack historical vintages
Overlapping forecast windows; uncertainty bootstrapped by business group
ERP snapshot and terminal cash balances excluded from historical forecast features
Synthetic shocks are hypotheses, never actual customer financials or ground truth for the challenge

contribution.approach: Ridge sobre delta de score, features bancarias internas más macro nacional (tipo BCE, USD/EUR, producción industrial, HICP y paro de España). No usa sector; el mismo join admitiría series NACE si hubiera CNAE.
